What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

Hi! Once an order has already shipped, it usually can’t be changed. 📦

That includes things like:

changing the shipping address
adding or removing items
canceling the order

If the issue is the shipping address, you can file a claim at claims.simplemodern.com to have the products resent to the correct address.

If you want, send me your order number and I can help check the status.

Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?

Hi! We’re generally not able to combine two separate orders into one shipment once they’ve been placed. 📦

Because orders move through fulfillment quickly, each order is processed separately.

If the orders were just placed, you can check the confirmation emails for the “Edit or View your order” button, but combining them into one shipment usually isn’t available.

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!

Can I change the payment method on my order?

Hi! You usually can’t change the payment method on an order after it’s placed.

What we can do instead:

If it’s been less than 40 minutes, the order can usually be canceled
Once canceled, you can place a new order with the payment method you want
If it’s been longer than 40 minutes, the payment method can’t be changed

If you want me to check your latest order, send your order number or the checkout email used for it 🙂
